name: spe-export-container-inventory-to-csv
title: Export SharePoint Embedded container inventory to CSV
shortDescription: Inventory every SharePoint Embedded container in the tenant (active, archived and deleted) with owning app, storage and sensitivity label, and export it to CSV.
longDescription: SharePoint Embedded containers do not appear in the SharePoint admin center site list and can only be viewed per application with no export. This script discovers the SharePoint Embedded applications in the tenant (Get-PnPContainerApplication where available, a built-in list of Microsoft applications, and container types owned by the tenant), then reads every active, archived and deleted container page by page, captures owning application, container type, billing classification, site URL, status, sensitivity label, owners, storage used and dates, writes a single CSV and prints a summary of container count and storage per application and state, plus the number of live containers without an owner or a sensitivity label. Works with PnP PowerShell 3.4.1 and later.
